text: dsh-browser 是面向 DSH agent 的 Playwright 浏览器自动化插件，通过注册 browser_* 工具让 agent 在同一浏览器会话中操作网页。它可以打开和导航页面、按 CSS 选择器点击或填写表单、选择下拉项，并读取页面文本或 HTML。插件还能执行页面 JavaScript、等待异步内容、截图并将结果保存到工作区；浏览器实例可在多个工具调用间复用，也可关闭后重新打开。适合需要让 DSH 自动浏览网页、填写页面表单、检查页面内容或保存截图的场景。运行需要本机可用的 Chromium 系浏览器，可配置浏览器通道、可执行文件、视口和超时；无需 API key。

dsh-browser gives DSH agents reusable Playwright browser tools. They can navigate pages, click selectors, fill forms, read text or HTML, evaluate page JavaScript, and save screenshots in the workspace. It requires a local Chromium based browser and no API key.
想让 DSH 自动打开网页并继续操作。
帮我用 CSS 选择器点击网页按钮并填写表单。
我需要让 agent 读取网页上的文字和 HTML。
网页加载慢或内容延迟出现时，怎么让 DSH 等一会儿再处理？
I want my DSH agent to browse pages and interact with forms.
Can DSH capture a webpage screenshot and save it in my workspace?
dsh-browser 的功能「网页截图」：browser_screenshot 将当前视口或整页保存为 PNG，可指定路径；默认写入工作区截图目录，并返回文件路径和尺寸。
dsh-browser 的功能「读取网页内容」：browser_get_text 读取匹配元素或整页可见文本，browser_get_html 返回匹配元素或整个文档的 HTML，并可限制返回长度。
dsh-browser 的功能「网页截图」：调用 browser_screenshot 将当前视口或整页保存为 PNG 到指定路径，默认放在工作区的 browser-screenshots 目录，并返回路径与尺寸。
dsh-browser 的功能「页面脚本求值」：browser_eval 在当前页面上下文执行给定表达式，并尽可能将结果转换为 JSON 可序列化的数据返回。
dsh-browser 的功能「浏览器会话管理」：浏览器由多个工具调用共享，首次需要页面时自动启动；browser_close 关闭实例，插件卸载时也会清理浏览器。
让 agent 自动从下拉菜单里选一个选项。
我想让 DSH 在网页里运行脚本并返回结果。

dsh-browser README · dsh-browser：Browser automation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a Playwright-powered `browser_*` tool family so the agent can drive real web pages — fill forms, click through flows, scrape SPA content, and take screenshots it can then view with `read_image`.

dsh-browser README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-browser
```

The plugin depends on `playwright-core` (bundled with the package) and needs a Chromium-based browser. It tries `chromium`, then `chrome`, then `msedge` channels automatically; if none is found:

```sh
npx playwright install chromium
```

or configure `launch.executablePath` / `launch.channel` in the plugin config.

dsh-browser README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `browser_open` | Open (or reuse) the browser, optionally navigate to a URL |
| `browser_navigate` | Navigate the current page and wait for load |
| `browser_click` | Click an element by CSS selector |
| `browser_type` | Type text into an input (optionally press Enter) |
| `browser_select` | Select option(s) in a `<select>` |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture a PNG to `<workspace>/browser-screenshots/`; view it with `read_image` |
| `browser_eval` | Evaluate JavaScript in the page, return JSON |
| `browser_get_text` / `browser_get_html` | Read visible text or outer HTML |
| `browser_wait` | Wait for slow pages / lazy content |
| `browser_close` | Close the browser (reopenable by any tool) |
| `browser_install` | Explain or verify browser availability |
dsh-browser README · Tools：The browser persists across tool calls — open once, drive many times, close when done.

dsh-browser README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `launch.executablePath` | — | Absolute path to a browser binary (takes precedence) |
| `launch.channel` | auto (`chromium` → `chrome` → `msedge`) | Browser channel |
| `launch.navigationTimeoutMs` | — | Default navigation/action timeout |
| `launch.viewport` | `1280×800` | Page viewport |
| `screenshotDir` | `browser-screenshots` | Screenshot directory under the workspace |

```yaml

dsh-browser README · profile cordis.patch.yml：- id: browser
  config:
    launch:
      channel: chrome
      navigationTimeoutMs: 30000
```

dsh-browser README · Notes：- Runs headless by default; a headed mode may come later.
- Screenshots land in the calling agent's workspace so the model can read them with `read_image`.
